column1: # The data partition is named "spiffs" because arduino-esp32's LittleFS library
# looks up that label by default. It is formatted as LittleFS.
# The coredump space is taken from app0 (which is 4 MB for a 1.5 MB image)
# NOT from spiffs: shrinking spiffs invalidates the existing LittleFS and the
# device reformats 11.5 MB on every boot
column2: which reads as a reboot loop.
not 64 KB: an ELF dump carries every task
